page.layout: One column of running text, with a Hebrew word and Greek words in the line. No marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: vi distinctione sententiam meam expli-co, Judæi aut habitabant in terra Israë-lis, aut in dispersione gentium. Prio-res nullos habebant Cyclos Paschales, nec ullam æquinoctii rationem ducebant, sed tantum אביב[?] & Lunæ Φεγγαρίς ; posteriores Cyclis utebantur, sed Brumæ, non Æquinoctii Cynosuram in iis componendis attendebant, ut ex Eliezere demonstratur. Hujus Epochæ seu clavis Paschalis instituendæ causa jam indicata est. Judæi dispersionis à Græcis hæc mutuati sunt. Græcis autem Alexandro regnante, nondum cordi erant æquinoctiales observationes, sed quæ tum maxime vigebat, periodus erat Calippica, quæ Brumæ insita & inoculata erat. Hinc Judæi ante Christum, Calippi Brumam & Enneadecaeterida secuti sunt, eamque Epiphanii tempore secuti videntur, ut ex Judiacæ periodi, quam enarrat, cum Eliezerea comparatione fortasse liquebit. Istis autem Epilogismis Judaicis initium factum est re-gnantibus Alexandri Successoribus. Lon-

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "sed tantum" is printed in a worn fount; my reading אביב is doubtful and is marked [?]. The Greek "Φεγγαρίς" is copied as printed. The last word of the page, "Lon-", breaks at the line end; its completion "go" is the catchword. Long s has been written as plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j normalised as instructed (e.g. "qvæ" to "quæ", "eamqve" to "eamque", "liqvebit" to "liquebit"). The printed "Successoribus" keeps its capital S.
